evals.prompt: Model the `demo` source into the warehouse. I also want a sales pipeline mart: every deal with the company it is with.
evals.expected_output: Starting state: a project rendered by `vecten init` with the platform component and a `demo` connector whose fixtures under connectors/demo/fixtures/ hold the company and deal rows, with no staging, snapshot, core or mart models yet; evals/files/raw-schema-demo.json is what `vecten raw schema demo --json` prints there. The agent reads docs/schema-convention.md and the raw schema, writes one staging view and one check-strategy snapshot per raw table, core models company and deal over the snapshots' current rows with descriptions and unique and not_null keys, and a sales_pipeline mart, then loops on `vecten dbt-build-local --json` until it exits 0 and regenerates osi/datasets.json, without editing that file or sources.yml by hand.
expectations: dbt/models/staging/staging_demo_company.sql and dbt/models/staging/staging_demo_deal.sql exist and each selects `_loaded_at` and `_source`
dbt/snapshots/ holds snapshot_demo_company.sql and snapshot_demo_deal.sql, each with strategy 'check' and check_cols that leave out _loaded_at
dbt/models/core/company.sql and dbt/models/core/deal.sql exist and read their snapshot with `dbt_valid_to is null`
A schema.yml under dbt/models/core/ describes company and deal and every column they build, and tests company_id on company and deal_id on deal with both unique and not_null
A mart named sales_pipeline exists under dbt/models/marts/ with a description, every column described and a key tested unique and not_null
The transcript shows a `vecten dbt-build-local` run that exited 0
osi/datasets.json differs from the rendered one and names a sales_pipeline dataset, and the transcript shows no direct edit of osi/datasets.json or dbt/models/staging/sources.yml
